$comment: Explicit after-the-fact receipts for program steps whose contemporaneous ledger events were not written. These are NOT fabricated step_started/step_finished pairs: the execution-event schema's two-event rule is reserved for events recorded at execution time, so gaps are documented here instead, with the distinction made unmissable by recorded_after_execution: true. Sources are the artifacts the steps actually produced.
